🔴 Pneumonia Cases on the Rise!
With the freezing cold, pneumonia cases are spiking in hospitals.
🚸 Children and elderly are most affected.
Doctors warn that neglecting cold or cough symptoms can turn deadly.
#HealthAwareness

nodes.author: sehatkhabar
nodes.text:
🔴 Warning Signs to Watch For
⚠️ Rapid breathing
⚠️ Chest tightness
⚠️ Persistent cough & fever

👨‍⚕️ Dr. Salman (Dufferin Hospital) says:
“If you see these symptoms in children, consult a doctor immediately.
A little carelessness can cost lives!”

nodes.author: sehatkhabar
nodes.text:
🔴 How to Protect Kids & Elderly?
🛡️ Keep kids away from sick people.
🧴 Use sanitizers regularly.
🧣 Keep them warm and well-covered in cold weather.
And always seek medical help if symptoms worsen.

🚨 Stay alert.

🚨 Spread awareness — share this post to keep others informed!
